events.title: 바닛 sack manager Barry Fry , despite being second-top of Division Three.

버밍엄 시티 coach Ian Atkins is appointed manager of 케임브리지 유나이티드. At the top end of the Division table, John Aldridge scores a hat-trick as Tranmere strengthen their hold on second place with a 5–2 win over 웨스트햄 유나이티드 at Prenton Park .

노팅엄 포리스트 win for only the third time in the league this season, beating Leeds 4–1 at Elland Road , but are still bottom of the table due to second-from-bottom 크리스털 팰리스 winning 2–0 at home to 셰필드 유나이티드. 노리치 시티 now have an eight-point lead at the top of the Premier League after beating 윔블던 2–1 at Carrow Road, while their nearest rivals 블랙번 로버스 find themselves on the receiving end of a John Hendrie hat-trick and a 3–2 defeat to 미들즈브러 at Ayresome Park. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 maintain their wide lead at the top of Division One with a 2–0 away win over 노츠 카운티.

Eric Cantona makes his debut for 맨체스터 유나이티드 as a substitute in a 2–1 win for his new club in the Manchester derby at Old Trafford . United are now fifth in the Premier League after three successive victories.

버밍엄 시티 are put up for sale with offers in the region of £750,000 invited for the 84% shareholding of former owner Samesh Kumar, who was recently declared bankrupt . 에버턴 beat 리버풀 2–1 in the Merseyside derby at Goodison Park , with 에버턴's Peter Beardsley becoming only the second player who have scored for both clubs in Merseyside derbies. The result lifts 에버턴 two places into 17th, while slip one place to 10th on goal difference.

John McGrath resigns as manager of Halifax Town, who are 17th in Division Three. Due to the club's desperate financial situation, they make the unorthodox move of appointing physiotherapist Mick Rathbone as manager for the remainder of the season.

입스위치 타운 sign Bulgarian striker Bontcho Guentchev from 스포르팅 for £250,000. 바닛 reinstate manager Barry Fry ten days after sacking him. 첼시 climb into second place in the Premier League with a goalless draw at 미들즈브러.
São Paulo FC wins the Intercontinental Cup in FC 도쿄, Japan by defeating Spain's 바르셀로나 (1–2). Raí scores twice for the Brazilians.

맨체스터 유나이티드 record a fourth successive Premier League victory, beating 노리치 시티 1–0 at Old Trafford with Mark Hughes scoring the only goal of the game. They are now third in the table and six points behind the leaders. 애스턴 빌라 beat 노팅엄 포리스트 2–1 at Villa Park to cut 노리치 시티's lead of the table to five points. Oldham fall into the relegation zone with a 5–2 defeat against 윔블던 at Selhurst Park, which lifts Joe Kinnear 's men out of the drop zone. 크리스털 팰리스 are level on points with both teams after defeating QPR 3–1 at Loftus Road .

블랙번 로버스 drop three more points when they lose 2–1 to 리버풀 at Anfield. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 suffer a rare defeat in Division One, losing 1–0 to 반즐리 at Oakwell . 브리스틀 로버스 climb out of the drop zone with an impressive 4–0 win over neighbours 브리스틀 시티 at Twerton Park .
Micky Quinn signs for 코번트리 시티 on a permanent basis for £250,000, having scored six goals in four matches on loan.
리버풀 sign Norway defender Stig Inge Bjørnebye from Rosenborg for £600,000. A takeover of 피터버러 유나이티드 sees manager Chris Turner installed as chairman, with Lil Fuccillo being appointed manager.

코번트리 시티 thrash 리버풀 5–1 at Highfield Road , inflicting 리버풀's heaviest league defeat for 16 years. Micky Quinn scores twice, taking his tally to eight goals in five matches, as does defender Brian Borrows . 애스턴 빌라 drop two points in their title, being held to a 1–1 draw with 맨체스터 시티 at Maine Road. Tranmere strengthen their hold on second place in Division One with a 3–0 home win over sixth-placed 울버햄프턴 원더러스.

Eric Cantona scores his first goal for 맨체스터 유나이티드 in a 1–1 league draw with 첼시 at Stamford Bridge . 크리스털 팰리스 beat Leeds 1–0 at Selhurst Park to make a third consecutive league title, lifting them out of the relegation zone.
노리치 시티 are still four points ahead at the top of the Premier League despite a 2–0 home defeat to their East Anglian rivals 입스위치 타운 , who are now sixth in the table.
첼시 sign Russian goalkeeper Dmitri Kharin from CSKA Moscow for £200,000.

맨체스터 유나이티드 draw 3–3 at 셰필드 웬즈데이 after being 3–0 down at half time, and are now second in the table behind 노리치 시티. Micky Quinn's good form for 코번트리 시티 continues as he scores twice in their 3–0 home win over title-chasing 애스턴 빌라, making it 10 goals in his first six games for the club. Alan Shearer scores in a 3–1 home win for 블랙번 로버스 over 리즈 유나이티드 to take his goals tally to 16 in the league and 22 in all competitions, but suffers a serious knee injury and is expected to be ruled out until next season. 크리스털 팰리스 win for the fourth game in succession, beating their tenants 윔블던 2–0 to climb up to 17th place and push them deeper into relegation trouble. In the Division One promotion race, 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 maintain a wide lead at the top of the table by beating 울버햄프턴 원더러스 2–1 at home, 웨스트햄 유나이티드's hopes of automatic promotion are dented when they are held to a 1–1 draw by Charlton at the recently reopened Valley, and 브렌트퍼드 and Grimsby both win their Boxing Day fixtures to close in the playoff places.

Andy Sinton scores a hat-trick in 퀸스 파크 레인저스' 4–2 win over 에버턴. 노리치 시티 are held to a goalless draw by Leeds at Elland Road, and 맨체스터 유나이티드 move into second place and cut their lead to three points by beating Coventry 5–0 at Old Trafford. 크리스털 팰리스 resume their upturn in form with a 1–0 win over 미들즈브러 at Ayresome Park. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 suffer only their fourth Division One defeat of the season when Oxford beat them 4–2 at the Manor Ground . More drama in the promotion race sees 포츠머스 beat 더비 카운티 4–2 at the Baseball Ground .
첼시 climb four places up to fifth in the Premier League with a 1–0 win over Leeds at Stamford Bridge.

The year ends with 노리치 시티 still leading the table, with a three-point lead over 맨체스터 유나이티드. 노팅엄 포리스트 remain bottom, 윔블던 remain in the relegation zone and 크리스털 팰리스 have moved clear of the bottom three at the expense of 셰필드 유나이티드. 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 enter the new year with their 12-point lead over 트랜미어 로버스 still intact. 웨스트햄 유나이티드, 밀월, 포츠머스 and 레스터 시티 occupy the playoff zone. Newly promoted 브렌트퍼드 occupy tenth position and are just two points short of the playoff zone which would give them a chance of reclaiming the top division place they lost in 1947. However, 버밍엄 시티's early promotion challenge has given way to a drastic loss of form that has pushed them to the bottom of Division One. Also facing the threat of relegation are 루턴 타운, who only slipped out of the top flight last season, and are only one point clear of the relegation zone, as well as 사우스엔드 유나이티드 and 케임브리지 유나이티드, who were both in last season's promotion hunt.
